title: Night Don Fall
tagline: The last danfo has dropped you. Your house is twenty minutes away, and agberos are somewhere ahead.

bonus.label: Keep the envelope and your phone
bonus.lostMessage: You lost the money or your phone, so the bonus is gone.
bonus.earnedLine: You kept the envelope and your phone. You get the bonus.

cash_low.label: No money left
cash_low.tip: You can't pay your way again.

dropped_name.label: You used a big name
dropped_name.tip: Lie is easier, until somebody checks.

text.default: The time is 10:40pm. The danfo conductor shouts "Last stop!" and everybody comes down. Your street lights are off, again. Your house is twenty minutes away on foot, and you and {rival} are both walking home. You are carrying ₦45,000 in an envelope. It's your younger sister's WAEC registration fee and you need to pay it tomorrow. If the money does not reach home tonight, she can't sit for the exam. Your mother thinks you are already home. She does not know you stayed out. A last keke is at the junction. The main road is dark but empty. Past the bridge, some agberos sit on the railings every night. Everybody knows.
text.coop: The time is 10:40pm. The danfo conductor shouts "Last stop!" and everybody comes down. Your street lights are off, again. Your house is twenty minutes away on foot, and you and {partner} are walking home together. You are carrying ₦45,000 in an envelope. It's your younger sister's WAEC registration fee and you need to pay it tomorrow. If the money does not reach home tonight, she can't sit for the exam. Your mother thinks you are already home. She does not know you stayed out. A last keke is at the junction. The main road is dark but empty. Past the bridge, some agberos sit on the railings every night. Everybody knows.
text.solo: The time is 10:40pm. The danfo conductor shouts "Last stop!" and everybody comes down. Your street lights are off, again. Your house is twenty minutes away on foot. You are carrying ₦45,000 in an envelope. It's your younger sister's WAEC registration fee and you need to pay it tomorrow. If the money does not reach home tonight, she can't sit for the exam. Your mother thinks you are already home. She does not know you stayed out. A last keke is at the junction. The main road is dark but empty. Past the bridge, some agberos sit on the railings every night. Everybody knows.

stakes.default: The envelope is in your pocket. Lose it, and your sister does not write WAEC. Lose your phone, and you cannot call home to explain.
stakes.coop: Stay close and stay smart. Whatever goes wrong now follows you down the road.

choices.label: Sweet-talk the last keke rider into one more trip
Walk fast down the main road, head down, no stopping
Fake a loud phone call: "Yes Daddy, I dey close, come out with the boys!"
Take the inner street where people are still outside

recap.default: {winner} sweet-talks the keke rider until he agrees, "Last one o. Enter." {loser} climbs in at the back, phone torch burning until the battery gives up.
recap.coop: You sweet-talk the keke rider until he agrees, "Last one o. Enter."

recap.default: {winner} walks the main road fast, with head down, eyes ahead. {loser} is behind.
recap.coop: You walk the main road fast, with head down, eyes ahead.

recap.default: {winner} shouts into the phone, "Yes Daddy, I dey close, come out with the boys!" Three guys by a pole stop talking. {loser} tries to pretend too but fails.
recap.coop: You shout into the phone, "Yes Daddy, I dey close, come out with the boys!" Three guys by a pole stop talking.

recap.default: {winner} turns into the inner street where generators are humming and people are still outside. {loser} follows, a little late and a little lost.
recap.coop: You turn into the inner street where generators are humming and people are still outside.

recap.default: {winner} tries to sweet-talk the keke rider, but he shakes his head and says "I don tire for tonight," and drives off.
recap.coop: You try to sweet-talk the keke rider, but he shakes his head and says "I don tire for tonight," and drives off.

recap.default: {winner} walks down the main road too fast, steps on a loose gutter slab, and the phone flies out of their hand. The torch breaks.
recap.coop: You walk down the main road too fast, step on a loose gutter slab, and the phone flies out of your hand. The torch breaks.

recap.default: {winner} shouts "Yes Daddy, come out with the boys!" but they are not convinced, and a voice by the pole laughs, "Which Daddy?"
recap.coop: You shout "Yes Daddy, come out with the boys!" but they are not convinced, and a voice by the pole laughs, "Which Daddy?"

recap.default: {winner} takes the inner street and walks straight into a burial canopy across the whole road: chairs, speakers, one very serious bouncer.
recap.coop: You take the inner street and walk straight into a burial canopy across the whole road: chairs, speakers, one very serious bouncer.

tie.recap: Nobody agrees, and the keke rider drives off while you argue. A woman roasting corn calls you into the inner street.

keke_ride.title: Last Trip
keke_ride.text: The keke bounces through potholes on one headlight. Fuji is playing on the radio and he does not say a word until the bridge shows up in the dark. He slows down. "This na where my road end," he says. "After this one, na agbero territory. I no dey go." He isn't asking. Ahead, the bridge railings have little red dots on them: cigarettes.

stakes.default: He drops you here unless you give him a reason to go further. A shorter road gets the envelope home sooner.
stakes.coop: He drops you here unless you give him a reason to go further.

choices.label: Ask him to keep his headlight on you until you cross. "Make dem see say person dey watch me."
Pay ₦2,500 and ask him to carry you past the bridge

lock.reason: You don't have money left to pay with.

choices.label: Tell him your father is a DPO and he will hear about this
Agree to stop here, but ask which lane the boys don't use

recap.default: {winner} asks him to keep the headlight on them until you leave. He grumbles, then keeps it on.
recap.coop: You ask him to keep the headlight on you until you leave. He grumbles, then keeps it on.

recap.default: {winner} pays ₦2,500. He counts it twice, mutters, then drives the keke straight over the bridge and past the agberos before they can stand up, and drops them at the vigilante post.
recap.coop: You pay ₦2,500. He counts it twice, mutters, then drives the keke straight over the bridge and past the boys before they can stand up, and drops you at the vigilante post.

recap.default: {winner} says "My father is DPO." His face tightens. He takes the bridge without a word, drops them at the next corner and does not say goodnight.
recap.coop: You say "My father is DPO." His face tightens. He takes the bridge without a word, drops you at the next corner and does not say goodnight.

recap.default: {winner} asks which lane the boys don't use. He points: "Behind the mechanic yard. It's dark, but nobody dey there."
recap.coop: You ask which lane the boys don't use. He points: "Behind the mechanic yard. It's dark, but nobody dey there."

recap.default: {winner} asks him to keep the light on. He ignores you, offs the engine, and the headlight dies. On the bridge, four heads turn toward the sound.
recap.coop: You ask him to keep the light on. He ignores you, offs the engine, and the headlight dies. On the bridge, four heads turn toward the sound.

recap.default: {winner} hands over ₦2,500. He takes it, stops at the bridge anyway, and says, "My own road end here." He drives off with the money.
recap.coop: You hand over ₦2,500. He takes it, stops at the bridge anyway, and says, "My own road end here." He drives off with the money.

recap.default: {winner} drops the DPO line. The rider laughs. "Every night, person be DPO pikin." He puts them down right there, loudly, in front of the boys.
recap.coop: You drop the DPO line. The rider laughs. "Every night, person be DPO pikin." He puts you down right there, loudly, in front of the boys.

recap.default: {winner} agrees to stop. He mumbles an answer but it goes unheard, and they walk into the wrong lane.
recap.coop: You agree to stop. He mumbles an answer, but you didn't hear him, and you walk into the wrong lane.

tie.recap: Nobody speaks. The rider shrugs and drops you at the foot of the bridge.

road_clear.title: Good Time
road_clear.text: You made good time. The street lamp is dead, but your eyes have adjusted to the darkness, and the bridge is two hundred metres ahead. Four figures sit on the railings. One of them flicks a cigarette into the water below. They are not looking your way yet, but they will. You remember the ₦45,000 in your pocket.

stakes.default: The bridge is the only fast way home. You can cross it, avoid it, or bluff your way through. Each choice costs something different.
stakes.coop: The bridge is the only fast way home. Cross together, split up, or find another way.

choices.label: Walk straight toward them, nod like you know somebody
Run across the bridge, don't stop, don't look back
Shout "Make una no worry, I dey come back with something for una!"
Slip down the bridge and pass through the gutter below

recap.default: {winner} walks up boldly, nods at the tallest one, and keeps walking. Nobody stops them. {loser} tries the same nod and gets stopped.
recap.coop: You walk up like you belong, nod at the tallest one, and keep walking. Nobody stops you.

recap.default: {winner} runs across the bridge, feet loud on the metal. The boys shout but do not chase. {loser} starts too late, gets halfway, and has to stop when one of them steps into the path.
recap.coop: You run across the bridge, feet loud on the metal. The boys shout but do not chase.

recap.default: {winner} shouts the promise across the dark. One of them laughs. Another says, "We go wait."
recap.coop: You shout the promise across the dark. One of them laughs. Another says, "We go wait."

recap.default: {winner} slips down the bridge, boots in the gutter water, and comes up past the bridge where nobody is watching. {loser} follows the gutter, misses the footing, and lands with a loud noise.
recap.coop: You slip down the bridge, boots in the gutter water, and come up past the bridge where nobody is watching.

recap.default: {winner} nods at the tallest one. He spits and says, "Why you dey look my face?" The others stand up.
recap.coop: You nod at the tallest one. He spits and says, "Why you dey look my face?" The others stand up.

recap.default: {winner} runs, slips on the wet rail, and crashes into the group. You immediately feel hands grab you roughly.
recap.coop: You run, slip on the wet rail, and crash into the group. You immediately feel hands grab you roughly.

recap.default: {winner} shouts the promise. A voice answers: "Which something? Come here!" Three of them drop down from the railings.
recap.coop: You shout the promise. A voice answers: "Which something? Come here!" Three of them drop down from the railings.

recap.default: {winner} slips down the bridge and lands in black water past the knees. The splash draws attention and someone points a torch from above. "Who dey there?"
recap.coop: You slip down the bridge and land in black water past the knees. The splash draws attention and someone points a torch from above. "Who dey there?"

tie.recap: You both freeze halfway across the bridge. The boys notice. One of them flicks a cigarette in your direction.

call_works.title: The Bluff Holds
call_works.text: The phone call worked. Three guys by the pole stopped talking. Now they watch you walk past with different eyes - not fear, they are calculating. They are deciding whether you are worth the trouble. The envelope is still in your pocket. The road ahead curves past the abattoir and opens toward your street. You are almost home.

stakes.default: The bluff worked for a while. If they test it, you need another move ready.
stakes.coop: The bluff worked for a while.

choices.label: Smile and say "My uncle na vigilante o. Make una take am easy."
Walk fast now, while they are still thinking
Turn back and shout "Una wan try me? I dey record everything!"
Cut through the abattoir yard. They won't follow you if you're fast

recap.default: {winner} drops the vigilante uncle line smooth. One of them shrugs. "No be our wahala."
recap.coop: You drop the vigilante uncle line smooth. One of them shrugs. "No be our wahala."

recap.default: {winner} walks fast, no looking back, and the distance stretches until the pole is just a dot.
recap.coop: You walk fast, no looking back, and the distance stretches until the pole is just a dot.

recap.default: {winner} turns back to shout. The words barely leave before somebody says, "Bring that phone come." {loser} is already too close to run.
recap.coop: You turn back to shout. The words barely leave before somebody says, "Bring that phone come."

recap.default: {winner} cuts through the abattoir yard, past the hanging hooks and the drain, and comes out where the streetlights work again. {loser} follows the smell and steps in mud and filth.
recap.coop: You cut through the abattoir yard, past the hanging hooks and the drain, and come out where the streetlights work again.

recap.default: {winner} mentions the vigilante uncle. One of them knows the man. "That one? He don transfer to Ogun State." The others laugh.
recap.coop: You mention the vigilante uncle. One of them knows the man. "That one? He don transfer to Ogun State." The others laugh.

recap.default: {winner} walks fast, too fast, and the envelope slips in the pocket. They grab it, stop to check, and the boys see the money.
recap.coop: You walk fast, too fast, and the envelope slips in the pocket. You grab it, stop to check, and the boys see the money.

recap.default: {winner} shouts about recording. Somebody says, "Phone wey no get battery?" They have been watching longer than you thought.
recap.coop: You shout about recording. Somebody says, "Phone wey no get battery?" They have been watching longer than you thought.

recap.default: {winner} cuts through the abattoir yard and finds the gate locked. The dogs behind it are awake and start barking. Backing out takes time you do not have.
recap.coop: You cut through the abattoir yard and find the gate locked. The dogs behind it are awake and start barking. Backing out takes time you do not have.

tie.recap: You both hesitate. The boys at the pole exchange looks. One of them starts walking toward you.

corn_aunty.title: Inner Street
corn_aunty.text: The inner street is alive. A woman roasts corn over charcoal, fanning the smoke. Two men argue about football near a generator that coughs every ten seconds. You are not alone here. But you need to get home quickly.

stakes.default: The inner street loops around to the bridge from the other side. You can rest here, cut through, or find another way entirely.
stakes.coop: The inner street loops toward the bridge. Stay together, or one of you walks into something blind.

choices.label: Buy corn and ask the aunty which road is safe tonight
Keep walking, cut through the school field, don't stop
Tell the football men you know thier Oga and you need escort
Slip past in the dark

recap.default: {winner} buys corn, and asks, and the aunty points: "Follow that light. No turn until you see the mosque." {loser} buys nothing, asks her, and she says she does not know anything.
recap.coop: You buy corn, and ask, and the aunty points: "Follow that light. No turn until you see the mosque."

recap.default: {winner} cuts through the school field, past the goalposts, and comes out on the main road past the bridge entirely. {loser} follows, trips on the chalk line, and the noise carries.
recap.coop: You cut through the school field, past the goalposts, and come out on the main road past the bridge entirely.

recap.default: {winner} drops Baba Risi's name. One of the football men straightens. "You know Baba Risi?" He walks with you to the corner, talking loud. {loser} says the same name and gets asked which Baba Risi.
recap.coop: You drop Baba Risi's name. One of the football men straightens. "You know Baba Risi?" He walks with you to the corner, talking loud.

recap.default: {winner} slips past. {loser} moves too early, the generator light catches them, and they are seen.
recap.coop: You slip past.

recap.default: {winner} asks the aunty. She looks at the corn, not at you. "All road na road," she says. "Na leg waka am."
recap.coop: You ask the aunty. She looks at the corn, not at you. "All road na road," she says. "Na leg waka am."

recap.default: {winner} runs across the school field and the envelope bounces out of the pocket. They catch it mid-air, but they notice some saw it from a distance.
recap.coop: You run across the school field and the envelope bounces out of the pocket. You catch it mid-air, but you notice some saw it from a distance.

recap.default: {winner} mentions Baba Risi. The football men look at each other. "Who be that?." They look confused.
recap.coop: You mention Baba Risi. The football men look at each other. "Who be that?." They look confused.

recap.default: {winner} waits to slip past but fails, and the generator roars back to life while they are still in the open. The corn aunty sees everything.
recap.coop: You wait to slip past but fail, and the generator roars back to life while you are still in the open. The corn aunty sees everything.

tie.recap: You both stand there too long. The corn aunty packs her coals. The football men go inside. The street empties, and you are alone with the dark.

keke_gone.title: Walk Now
keke_gone.text: The keke is gone. The junction is empty. The main road stretches ahead with no light and no noise, and the bridge is somewhere in the dark between here and your house. You start walking. Your shoes on the tarmac are the only sound. Then they are not. Somebody coughs behind you, you are being followed.

stakes.default: No ride, no shortcut. The bridge is ahead. What is behind you is unknown.
stakes.coop: No ride, no shortcut. Walk together, or split the risk and the protection.

choices.label: Turn and shout "Who dey there?"
Start run. Full sprint. Reach the bridge before they catch up
Stop, face the dark, and say "I get boys for front. Una wan try?"
Slip into an uncompleted building ahead and let them pass

recap.default: {winner} turns and shouts. The cough stops. Whoever it was changes direction, or was never there. {loser} turns too late, and the footsteps behind speed up.
recap.coop: You turn and shout. The cough stops. Whoever it was changes direction, or was never there.

recap.default: {winner} sprints, reaches the bridge breathing hard, and the boys on the railings watch. {loser} sprints too but stumbles.
recap.coop: You sprint, reach the bridge breathing hard, and the boys on the railings watch.

recap.default: {winner} stops and bluffs into the dark. The footsteps stop too. A voice says, "We go see." Then nothing. {loser} says the same words but their voice cracks in fear.
recap.coop: You stop and bluff into the dark. The footsteps stop too. A voice says, "We go see." Then nothing.

recap.default: {winner} slips into the uncompleted building, presses against the raw concrete, and watches a single figure walk past. It's jst one person, walking home. {loser} steps on a bottle. The figure stops.
recap.coop: You slip into the uncompleted building, press against the raw concrete, and watch a single figure walk past. It's jst one person, walking home.

recap.default: {winner} turns and shouts. A voice answers: "Na who you dey shout for?" Three men come out from behind the wall.
recap.coop: You turn and shout. A voice answers: "Na who you dey shout for?" Three men come out from behind the wall.

recap.default: {winner} sprints, does not see the open gutter, and falls hard. The envelope is still there. Their ankle is spained and the footsteps behind getting closer.
recap.coop: You sprint, do not see the open gutter, and fall hard. The envelope is still there. Your ankle is spained and the footsteps behind getting closer.

recap.default: {winner} bluffs into the dark. The answer comes immediate: "We be the boys for front." They are not afraid.
recap.coop: You bluff into the dark. The answer comes immediate: "We be the boys for front." They are not afraid.

recap.default: {winner} slips into the uncompleted building and finds it occupied. Three men on a mattress, one holding a phone torch. "Who be that?," he says.
recap.coop: You slip into the uncompleted building and find it occupied. Three men on a mattress, one holding a phone torch. "Who be that?," he says.

tie.recap: You both keep walking, fast but not running. The cough fades. Or you outwalked it. Or they are waiting ahead.

road_snag.title: Torch Gone
road_snag.text: Your phone is dead. The torch is gone. It is very dark but you know the road. You have walked it a hundred times. But never without light. Never with ₦45,000 in your pocket and agberos somewhere ahead. The bridge is close. You can smell the gutter.

stakes.default: No light and no phone so call for help. The bridge is ahead.
stakes.coop: No light and no phone. Stay close, or lose each other in the dark.

choices.label: Call out softly: "If anybody dey there, abeg make I pass. I no get wahala."
Feel your way forward, hands on the wall, step by step
Shout "I know this area! Una no fit surprise me!"
Crawl along the gutter edge - if you feel water, you are too close to the bridge drop

recap.default: {winner} calls out soft. A voice answers: "Pass." {loser} calls too loud, and the same voice says, "Come here first."
recap.coop: You call out soft. A voice answers: "Pass."

recap.default: {winner} feels the wall, counts the gates, and knows the bridge is ten metres ahead when the concrete changes to metal.
recap.coop: You feel the wall, count the gates, and know the bridge is ten metres ahead when the concrete changes to metal.

recap.default: {winner} shouts into the dark. The answer is laughter, close, from both sides of the road. They were waiting for noise.
recap.coop: You shout into the dark. The answer is laughter, close, from both sides of the road. They were waiting for noise.

recap.default: {winner} crawls the gutter edge, feels the water rise, and stops exactly where the bridge begins. {loser} crawls too far, gets wet, and the splashing attracts attention.
recap.coop: You crawl the gutter edge, feel the water rise, and stop exactly where the bridge begins.

recap.default: {winner} calls out. The answer comes from three directions at once. "Wahala don reach you already."
recap.coop: You call out soft. The answer comes from three directions at once. "Wahala don reach you already."

recap.default: {winner} feels the wall and walks into an open compound gate. The dog inside is not on a chain. The barking brings lights and more attention.
recap.coop: You feel the wall and walk into an open compound gate. The dog inside is not on a chain. The barking brings lights and more attention.

recap.default: {winner} shouts confidently. Somebody sparks a lighter close enough to smell. "Blind man with loud mouth. Come here."
recap.coop: You shout confidently. Somebody sparks a lighter close enough to smell. "Blind man with loud mouth. Come here."

recap.default: {winner} crawls the gutter, feels water, keeps crawling. The water gets deeper. The bridge was further than remembered.
recap.coop: You crawl the gutter, feel water, keep crawling. The water gets deeper. The bridge was further than remembered.

tie.recap: You both stand still in the dark, listening. The bridge is somewhere ahead. So are they. Nobody moves. Then somebody moves.

call_exposed.title: They Know You
call_exposed.text: The phone call was fake. They know. The voice by the pole laughed, and now the pole is empty. They are not on the railings anymore. They are somewhere in the dark between you and the bridge, and they know you have no father waiting, no boys coming.

stakes.default: They know you are alone. They know you are bluffing. The only question left is what you have that they want.
stakes.coop: They know the lie. If one of you has something real, now is the time.

choices.label: Smile and say "Na play I dey play o. Make una no vex."
Run for the inner street, lose them in the turns
Shout "My uncle na DPO! Anybody touch me, una go sleep for cell!"
Drop ₦2,000 on the ground and walk away while they look

lock.reason: You don't have money left to drop.

recap.default: {winner} laughs it off, calls it play, and the tension breaks. They let you pass, bored now. {loser} laughs too late, too hard, and the boredom turns back.
recap.coop: You laugh it off, call it play, and the tension breaks. They let you pass, bored now.

recap.default: {winner} runs for the inner street, turns twice, and the footsteps behind fade away. {loser} runs straight, not turning, and the footsteps follow straight.
recap.coop: You run for the inner street, turn twice, and the footsteps behind fade away.

recap.default: {winner} drops the DPO line. Somebody says, "Every night, one DPO pikin."
recap.coop: You drop the DPO line. Somebody says, "Every night, one DPO pikin."

recap.default: {winner} drops the money, walks slow, does not look back. Behind them, the sound of picking up. Then silence. Then nothing follows.
recap.coop: You drop the money, walk slow, do not look back. Behind you, the sound of picking up. Then silence. Then nothing follows.

recap.default: {winner} calls it play. Somebody says, "We like play too." The bridge railings are cold against your back as they push you against it.
recap.coop: You call it play. Somebody says, "We like play too." The bridge railings are cold against your back as they push you against it.

recap.default: {winner} runs, but they know the area better. There is a dead end and nowhere left to run.
recap.coop: You run, but they know the area better. There is a dead end and nowhere left to run.

recap.default: {winner} shouts DPO. The answer: "We don report ourself to DPO last week. He say make we continue." They laugh.
recap.coop: You shout DPO. The answer: "We don report ourself to DPO last week. He say make we continue." They laugh

recap.default: {winner} reaches for money that is not there. The pocket is empty.
recap.coop: You reach for money that is not there. The pocket is empty.

tie.recap: You both freeze, waiting for the other to move. They do not wait. Footsteps come from three directions.

street_blocked.title: Dead End
street_blocked.text: The road is blocked. You are not going forward. Behind you, the way back is still open. For now. You can hear them coming.

stakes.default: Blocked forward, exposed behind. Find another way, go back, or make the block work for you.
stakes.coop: Blocked together. Split up, or find one path that fits two.

choices.label: Talk to the bouncer. "Abeg, I get emergency for house."
Climb the fence, drop down, keep moving
Shout "Make una open this gate!"
Go back the way you came, find the other turn you missed

recap.default: {winner} talks soft and the bouncer lifts the rope. "Pass. Fast." {loser} talks too long, and the bouncer ignores.
recap.coop: You talk soft, and the bouncer lifts the rope. "Pass. Fast."

recap.default: {winner} climbs, drops, lands running. The other side is empty street, open road, the last road home. {loser} climbs, drops, lands wrong, and injures their ankle.
recap.coop: You climb, drop, land running. The other side is empty street, open road, the last road home.

recap.default: {winner} shouts at the gate. The bouncer shouts back. The noise brings attention from everywhere. {loser} shouts too, and the attention doubles.
recap.coop: You shout at the gate. The bouncer shouts back. The noise brings attention from everywhere.

recap.default: {winner} goes back, finds the turn, and the inner street opens up with light and noise again. {loser} goes back, misses the turn, and walks in a circle.
recap.coop: You go back, find the turn, and the inner street opens up with light and noise again.

recap.default: {winner} says there is an emergency. The bouncer says, "Everybody get emergency." The rope stays down.
recap.coop: You say there is an emergency. The bouncer says, "Everybody get emergency." The rope stays down.

recap.default: {winner} climbs, catches the top, and the fence wobbles. They fall back, loud, into the light of a phone torch.
recap.coop: You climb, catch the top, and the fence wobbles. You fall back, loud, into the light of a phone torch.

recap.default: {winner} shouts at the gate. The bouncer opens it, steps out, and closes it behind him. "You dey shout for my gate?"
recap.coop: You shout at the gate. The bouncer opens it, steps out, and closes it behind him. "You dey shout for my gate?"

recap.default: {winner} goes back into the dark, takes the wrong turn, and the road ends at the riverbank. No bridge. No way forward. Only back to where you are coming from.
recap.coop: You go back into the dark, take the wrong turn, and the road ends at the riverbank. No bridge. No way forward. Only back to where you are coming from.

tie.recap: You both hesitate at the block. The bouncer watches. The dark behind you moves. Somebody coughs, close now.

bridge_toll.title: The Bridge
bridge_toll.text: The bridge is metal and dark. Four boys sit on the railings, or stand near them, or lean against the pillars. They have seen you coming. The road beyond the bridge is your street, but first, you have to cross this bridge.

stakes.default: They want something. Money, respect, entertainment. What you give them decides what happens after.
stakes.coop: They want something. Give it together, or one of you gives more than the other.

choices.label: Greet them properly: "Evening, brothers. How body?"
Walk through like you are already late, no stopping
Say "I don pay una chairman already."
Offer ₦1,500 and ask them to watch your back.

lock.reason: You don't have money left to offer.

recap.default: {winner} greets properly, asks after their people, and they allow you pass. "Pass, brother." {loser} greets nervously, and they don't allow.
recap.coop: You greet properly, ask after their people, and they allow you pass. "Pass, brother."

recap.default: {winner} walks through, fast but not running, eyes front, and the boys let you pass. {loser} walks too fast, shows fear, and fear is what they catch.
recap.coop: You walk through, fast but not running, eyes front, and the boys let you pass.

recap.default: {winner} claims they paid. One of them checks his phone, nods slow, and the path clears. {loser} claims the same, gets asked which chairman, but there is no answer.
recap.coop: You claim you paid. One of them checks his phone, nods slow, and the path clears.

recap.default: {winner} offers money for escort. The tallest one takes it, and promises to watch your back. {loser} offers too little.
recap.coop: You offer money for escort. The tallest one takes it, and promises to watch your back.

recap.default: {winner} greets properly. The answer: "We no be your brothers." The railings are cold when they press you against them.
recap.coop: You greet properly. The answer: "We no be your brothers." The railings are cold when they press you against them.

recap.default: {winner} walks through, and they set leg. You fall hard. The envelope falls out of your pocket. They see it.
recap.coop: You walk through, and they set leg. You fall hard. The envelope falls out of your pocket. They see it.

recap.default: {winner} claims payment. "Which chairman?" The question hangs. The answer does not come. They immediately begin searching you and take your phone.
recap.coop: You claim payment. "Which chairman?" The question hangs. The answer does not come. They immediately begin searching you and take your phone.

recap.default: {winner} offers money. "That one na for yesterday. Today get new price." They immediately search you and see the envelope.
recap.coop: You offer money. "That one na for yesterday. Today get new price." They immediately search you and see the envelope.

tie.recap: You both reach the bridge at the same time but hesitate, and they start walking towards you.

bridge_heated.title: Trouble
bridge_heated.text: The boys have stepped down from the railings. The envelope is in your pocket. Your phone is in your hand. What matters is what you say next, and how fast.

stakes.default: This is the moment before the moment. Talk your way out, pay your way out, or prepare to lose something you cannot replace.
stakes.coop: This is the moment before the moment. Stand together, or fall separately.

choices.label: Calm and soft: "Brothers, I no get wahala. Make una tell me wetin I fit do."
Hand over the phone and ₦5,000, ask to walk

lock.reason: You don't have enough money left.

choices.label: Shout "I sabi Oga T! Make una call am ask am!"
Drop the envelope on the ground and run while they look

recap.default: {winner} talks softly, and the tallest one spits and says, "Go. Before I change my mind." {loser} talks too long, and the mind changes.
recap.coop: You talk softly, and the tallest one spits and says, "Go. Before I change my mind."

recap.default: {winner} hands over phone and money. The tallest one counts it, pockets it, and steps aside. "You be smart person." {loser} hesitates on the amount, and they immediately snatch everything.
recap.coop: You hand over phone and money. The tallest one counts it, pockets it, and steps aside. "You be smart person."

recap.default: {winner} drops Oga T's name. Somebody actually calls. Somebody actually answers. The phone is handed back. "Oga T say make we leave you." {loser} isn't so lucky.
recap.coop: You drop Oga T's name. Somebody actually calls. Somebody actually answers. The phone is handed back. "Oga T say make we leave you."

recap.default: {winner} drops the envelope, runs, and you can hear them fighting over the money. You are past the bridge before they look up.
recap.coop: You drop the envelope, run, and you can hear them fighting over the money. You are past the bridge before they look up.

recap.default: {winner} tries to talk. The answer is a heavy slap. "We no be your brothers." The envelope leaves with them. You leave with your life.
recap.coop: You try to talk. The answer is a heavy slap. "We no be your brothers." The envelope leaves with them. You leave with your life.

recap.default: {winner} reaches for money that is not there. The pocket is empty. They take the phone. At least the emvelope is still there. Small mercy.
recap.coop: You reach for money that is not there. The pocket is empty. The gesture of reaching is enough. They take the phone. At least the emvelope is still there. Small mercy.

recap.default: {winner} shouts Oga T. The answer: "Oga T don die." The laughter after is worse than the blow. They take the envelope and phone. You go away quickly when they are done laughing.
recap.coop: You shout Oga T. The answer: "Oga T don die." The laughter after is worse than the blow. They take the envelope and phone. You go away quickly when they are done laughing.

recap.default: {winner} drops the envelope, runs, and trips on the rail gap. The envelope falls toward the water. They dive for the money, not for you. You crawl away, empty, but at least alive.
recap.coop: You drop the envelope, run, and trip on the rail gap. The envelope falls toward the water. They dive for the money, not for you. You crawl away, empty, but at least alive.

tie.recap: You both freeze, waiting for the other to move. They do not wait. They take the phone and envelope.

vigilante_post.title: Almost Home
vigilante_post.text: The vigilante post is a folding chair under a bulb that flickers. Two men in mismatched uniforms sit there, or stand, or lean against the wall. They have seen you before. The road from here to your house is three minutes if you run, five if you walk.

stakes.default: The vigilante men can walk you home, or not. They can remember your face, or not. The last stretch is yours to lose.
stakes.coop: The last stretch. Together, or one at a time, with or without escort.

choices.label: Thank them properly, ask if they can watch you to your gate
Walk fast now, no stopping, almost there
Say "If anything happen to me, una go hear am for morning. My people sabi una face."
Take the back path behind the church, there are no streetlights but no agberos either

recap.default: {winner} thanks them properly and asks soft, and one of them stands, stretches, and walks to your gate. "Go inside. Lock am."
recap.coop: You thank them properly and ask soft, and one of them stands, stretches, and walks to your gate. "Go inside. Lock am."

recap.default: {winner} walks fast, turns the corner, sees the gate, and quickly opens the gate. {loser} walks fast, turns a wrong turn and takes more time.
recap.coop: You walk fast, turn the corner, see the gate, and the key is in your hand before the door.

recap.default: {winner} drops the threat, and the vigilante man nods slow. "We go dey here."
recap.coop: You drop the threat, and the vigilante man nods slow. "We go dey here."

recap.default: {winner} takes the back path, past the church, past the graveyard edge, and sees the gate, waiting. {loser} takes the path but misses the turn.
recap.coop: You take the back path, past the church, past the graveyard edge, and see the gate, waiting.

recap.default: {winner} asks for escort. "We no dey do escort." The chair stays folded. You walk the road alone.
recap.coop: You ask for escort. "We no dey do escort." The chair stays folded. You walk the road alone.

recap.default: {winner} walks fast, too fast, and the gate is locked. Mum is asleep. The knocking wakes the street. The envelope is safe but your secret is not.
recap.coop: You walk fast, too fast, and the gate is locked. Mum is asleep. The knocking wakes the street. The envelope is safe but your secret is not.

recap.default: {winner} threatens the vigilante. They do not answer. They do not need to. The look is enough. You walk the last stretch without any protection.
recap.coop: You threaten the vigilante. They do not answer. They do not need to. The look is enough. You walk the last stretch without any protection.

recap.default: {winner} takes the back path. The gate is finally ahead.
recap.coop: You take the back path. The gate is finally ahead.

tie.recap: You both stand at the vigilante post, unsure. One of them looks up, sighs, and points. "That way. Go."

back_lane.title: The Long Way
back_lane.text: The back lane is narrow, unlit, and smells of engine oil from the mechanic yard. You cannot see the bridge from here. You cannot see much of anything. But the keke man was right - nobody is here. You only hear your footsteps.

stakes.default: The long way is the safe way, until it is not. No boys, no vigilante, no help. Just you and the dark and the envelope.
stakes.coop: The long way together. Stay close, or the dark swallows one of you first.

choices.label: Whistle a song, loud, so anyone ahead knows you are coming
Run and don't stop for anything
Shout "I dey come o! Make nobody surprise me!"
Walk slow, hug the wall, listen for any sound that isn't yours.

recap.default: {winner} whistles loud, off-key, and the sound fills the lane like light. Nobody answers. Nobody is there. The other end opens to the main road, past the bridge, home.
recap.coop: You whistle loud, off-key, and the sound fills the lane like light. Nobody answers. Nobody is there. The other end opens to the main road, past the bridge, home.

recap.default: {winner} runs, bursts out the other side, and the vigilante post is right there, the bulb flickering, safety in sight. {loser} runs, stumbles on the oil slick, and falls.
recap.coop: You run, burst out the other side, and the vigilante post is right there, the bulb flickering, safety in sight.

recap.default: {winner} shouts ahead, and the echo answers alone. The lane is empty. It was always empty.
recap.coop: You shout ahead, and the echo answers alone. The lane is empty. It was always empty.

recap.default: {winner} walks slowly, listens, hears only their own heart, and reaches the end with the envelope dry and the hands steady. {loser} walks too fast, misses the turn, and the lane doubles back toward the bridge.
recap.coop: You walk slowlt, listen, hear only your own heart, and reach the end with the envelope dry and your hands steady.

recap.default: {winner} whistles. The answer is a stone thrown from nowhere, clanging off the corrugated iron. "Who dey sing for my father's house?"
recap.coop: You whistle. The answer is a stone thrown from nowhere, clanging off the corrugated iron. "Who dey sing for my father's house?"

recap.default: {winner} runs, slips on the oil, and the crash brings light from the mechanic yard window. Faces appear. Not friendly ones.
recap.coop: You run, slip on the oil, and the crash brings light from the mechanic yard window. Faces appear. Not friendly ones.

recap.default: {winner} shouts warning. The answer comes from behind: "We no dey surprise people. We dey wait for dem." The lane is narrower than you thought.
recap.coop: You shout warning. The answer comes from behind: "We no dey surprise people. We dey wait for dem." The lane is narrower than you thought.

recap.default: {winner} walks slow, listening.
recap.coop: You walk slow, listening.

tie.recap: You both walk the lane in silence, too careful, too slow. The end comes eventually. The main road. The lights. The way home.

home_safe.title: Inside
home_safe.text: The gate closes behind you. The lock turns. You put the envelope on the kitchen table. She does not ask where you were. She takes the envelope, counts it without looking, and says, "Go and sleep. We'll deal with it tomorrow." The exam fee is safe. That is what matters.

stakes.default: You made it. The sister writes WAEC. The secret stays yours. The night ends.
stakes.coop: You made it together. Whatever happened on the road, the kitchen table is the same.

choices.label: Hug Mum before she can ask where you were
Put the envelope in her hand before you even take off your shoes
Tell her you were at a friend's place and got late
Count the money out on the table, then tell her the truth

endings.win: You reach the gate first and put the envelope on the kitchen table, every naira of it. Mum counts it without looking and says, "Go and sleep." {loser} is still on the road.
endings.loss: You reach home safe with the envelope, but {winner} is already inside. At least your little sister will write her WAEC.

success.default: You both reach your gates with the envelope safe and nobody asks where you were.
success.solo: You reach the gate with the envelope safe and Mum does not ask where you were.

endings.fail: You get home with the envelope, but so late that Mum has called six times.

home_late.title: Too Late
home_late.text: The gate is locked. The house is dark. You knock soft, then loud, then the neighbour's dog barks and Mum's light comes on. She opens the window, not the gate, looks at you and says nothing. You sit on the step until she comes down. The night is over. The trouble is not.

stakes.default: You survived the road but lost what you carried. The sister does not write WAEC. The morning brings questions you cannot answer.
stakes.coop: You survived together, or one of you did, but what you carried is gone. The morning brings questions.

choices.label: Apologise soft through the window before she says anything
Knock on the gate until she comes down, then tell her fast
Tell her the bus broke down and a stranger helped you home
Sit on the step and wait for her to come down, then tell her what happened

endings.win: You reach the gate first, with nothing left to carry, and tell Mum straight. {loser} is still on the road. You failed your sister.
endings.loss: {winner} gets home first. You sit on the step with nothing to carry in.

success.default: You both get home with nothing left to carry. Mum comes down the stairs, and the morning will bring questions neither of you can answer yet.
success.solo: You get home with nothing left to carry. Mum comes down the stairs, and the morning will bring questions you cannot answer yet.

endings.win: You reach home first and the envelope is safe. Your sister writes WAEC, and {loser} gets there after.
endings.loss: {winner} gets home first. Your sister's WAEC fee is still on your mind all night.

success.default: You both get home. Your sister writes WAEC, and Mum never asks where you were.
success.solo: You get home. Your sister writes WAEC, and Mum never asks where you were.

fail.default: You get home late and shaken. The morning brings the WAEC deadline, and nobody has an answer yet.
fail.solo: You get home late and shaken. The morning brings the WAEC deadline, and you have no answer yet.

epilogues.text: Since that night, you read every street before you walk it.
The boys on the bridge now greet you by name whenever you pass. They respect you.
The boys on the bridge still remember your face. Take another road for a while.
The vigilante men save a chair for you now. They like you
You check your pocket that night and almost cry.
You are still patting the pocket where the phone used to be.
Somewhere on that road, somebody is still wondering who your uncle is.
